localChanges: With the New interface preview on, choosing a city in the Happiness report shows why its citizens are as they are in a panel at the foot of the window, in view whichever row you chose, and the row stays marked (closes #793).
With the New interface preview on, the City Status report's Corruption column has an icon, the Trade icon with a black arrow, like the columns beside it (closes #792).
With the New interface preview on, there's more room above the upkeep total in the city screen (closes #791).
A report's filter now matches what its rows show even when they change after they're drawn, and the filter box is hidden when there's nothing to filter (closes #664).
The icons on a unit's order buttons stay sharp when you zoom the browser or move the window to another screen (closes #358).
